text: Computer vision is a field of artificial intelligence that teaches computers to see and understand the world through images or videos. At its core, it involves two main tasks: image recognition, which identifies what is in a picture, and object detection, which locates multiple items within the same scene. This technology has many practical applications. In healthcare, it helps doctors analyze X-rays for early signs of disease. In retail, it powers checkout-free stores that track what customers pick up. The most exciting use, however, is in self-driving cars. These vehicles rely on computer vision to recognize traffic lights, pedestrians, and other vehicles in real time, making split-second decisions to keep passengers and road users safe.
